title: Bounded autonomous continuation for /goal (Task-Manager-backed, self-verified stop)

AC1.note: parseGoalArgs bounded 2-flag trailing peel. 14 tests pass.

AC2.note: autoProvisionFlow(): init->AC write->freeze->start, bound via writeSlate. 3 integration tests pass.

AC3.note: loop while-condition reads slateSession.opened (set by closeSlateOnFlowDone's own isCourseDone check). Mid-loop-done test confirms early stop.

AC4.note: src/commands/goal-command.ts: runGoalVerifier() finds deps.tools' spawn_subagent, dispatches mode:read_only, parseVerifierVerdict() extracts {achieved,gaps} from free text (never throws). On achieved:false + budget remaining: reopens (ensureSlateOpened + fresh Anchors) and rebinds boundFlowRef/boundWorkspaceId snapshotted at T8 arm time, then runs exactly one more round. 8 new tests: achieved:true no-op, budget-exhausted stops+surfaces gaps, budget-remaining reopens+rebinds+one extra round (verified via the round's own continuation message naming the same flow id, since the flow closes again by test end), unreachable/throwing verifier degrades silently, unparseable output degrades silently, no spawn_subagent tool wired in degrades silently, plus 3 pure parseVerifierVerdict unit tests. All pass; typecheck clean; 490 tests across the broader /goal+session+flow+spawn-subagent regression suite green.

AC5.note: roundsLeft decremented for both ordinary and verifier-triggered rounds — same counter, no separate budget. --auto 2 stops at exactly 3 calls; --auto 1 override confirmed.

AC7.note: autoGoalRounds lives only on the SlateSessionRef instance. Forked-session test confirms non-inheritance.

AC6.note: By construction: every continuation round (T9) and the verifier-triggered extra round (T10) call the exact same runAgentTurn(io, deps, history, text, turnOptions) with the SAME turnOptions object as the first turn — no new tool-execution, approval, or policy-related code was introduced anywhere in T6-T10's diff (confirmed by review: goal-command.ts imports/touches nothing from permission-mode.ts or the tool-execution path). resolveApprovalDecision is entirely inside runAgentTurnCore's own tool-dispatch, untouched.

AC8.note: closeSlateOnFlowDone/dispatchWrapUpBestEffort are not touched by T6-T10's diff at all — every continuation/verifier round reuses runAgentTurn's own finally block unchanged. Evidence: (1) the existing SLATE-18 wrap-up suite (agent.test.ts) passes unmodified in the broader regression run; (2) this flow's own AC3 test ('the loop stops as soon as the bound flow's status flips to done') exercises the REAL (non-mocked) close+wrap-up path during a --auto run and confirms slateSession.opened flips to false with no error, matching non-auto behavior.

AC9.note: /goal's AGENT_SLASH_COMMANDS registry entry (agent-commands.ts) has modes: ['agent'] (AGENT_ONLY) covering the whole command including --auto, which is parsed as part of the same raw text by the same parseGoalArgs/runGoalCommand — no new chat-mode dispatch path was added. Existing test 'SLATE-15: /goal is agent-only' (agent-commands.test.ts:54) already covers this; --auto inherits it structurally, not via new code.
